extraction.notes: Company reports FFO and Core FFO only; no AFFO metric, so affo_total is null and affo fields are empty/null. Reconciliation is on the [[PAGE seq=11]] marker (printed page marker blank; the page footer reads '- 7 -'); the same figures repeat at seq=16 (printed S-3). Share count printed as 66,551,838 in full; divided by 1,000 to 66,551.838 thousand. Check: 253,533 / 66,551.838 = 3.81; 260,002 / 66,551.838 = 3.91. Dash (zero) current-quarter lines included with amount 0: Casualty loss, Impairment loss from unconsolidated co-investments, Expensed acquisition and investment related costs, Co-investment promote income, Income from early redemption. The 'Depreciation attributable to third party ownership and other' line was categorized as 'other' (it is the third-party/noncontrolling share of depreciation). Insurance reimbursements, legal settlements line categorized as legal; it includes legal settlement gains of $42.5 million for nine months (footnote), not the quarter. Recurring capex: not applicable since no AFFO is reported; left null.
